darius (AE): Convex wants a short POC: prove sustained 300 qps (30m) with p99 < 150ms, cold-starts < 800ms, and 10min bursts to 1k qps. They also sent a security checklist. Can we run Wed (smoke) + Thu (sustained + stress)?
elaine (SE): Yes. Plan: Wed 10m smoke + 10m warm cache; Thu AM 30m sustained @300 qps; Thu PM 3x 10m bursts to 1k. Model: rwin-13b-quant with rwin-6b fallback. Include 2% embedding mix.
chris (SRE): I'll reserve a Dedicated pool (3 A100-equivalent nodes) for Thu. Need input/output token averages from Convex and the IPs for allowlist. Will capture cold vs warm latencies and GPU util.
darius (AE): Convex reports avg input 40-50 tokens, avg output ~60. They prefer hosted pricing but asked for a dedicated vs hosted cost compare.
elaine (SE): Quick hosted estimate: ~100 tokens/call * $0.00075/token = $0.075/call. At 300 qps for 1h (~1.08M calls) that's ~$81k. Burst 1k qps for 10m (~600k calls) ~ $45k. I'll send a detailed spreadsheet; dedicated will reduce per-token cost significantly.
olivia (Security): On security checklist: Hosted uses cloud KMS (no customer HSM). Private supports customer KMS/HSM and 12mo audit log retention as an add-on. SOC2 link will be attached. Hosted default logs 90d; 12mo available with billing approval.
darius (AE): HSM requirement could be a blocker for Hosted; flagging to Convex.
elaine (SE): We'll provide a locust script and a sample API key for the runner. Canary policy: auto-fallback to 6b if p99 > 500ms for 2+ minutes. We'll validate that during stress.
chris (SRE): Also recommend a 10m warm phase before measuring to populate KV caches. I'll enable tracing hooks and capture histograms for p50/p95/p99.
eval-bot: [queued] scenario: convex-poc-1759 id: run-042.
darius (AE): Thanks — please paste final scripts, exact Dedicated sizing, and security answers by EOD Mon so I can send the schedule and AUP to Convex. :thumbsup:
